name: CookieCuttr
description: Adds an EU cookie-policy consent notice/banner to every page by wiring Drupal config into the CookieCuttr jQuery plugin.
project_description:
The CookieCuttr module helps site owners to comply with the EU Directive on Privacy and Electronic Communications, known as the "Cookie law".

It presents site visitors with information and an opportunity to give or withhold consent to the use of cookies, by providing Drupal integration for the CookieCuttr jQuery plugin.

 All the various configuration options documented at https://github.com/cdwharton/cookieCuttr/wiki/Options can be controlled via the CMS

 Alternatives 
 
 Cookie Control 
 EU Cookie Compliance
